capture_boundary.meaning: Single outbound choke point (node.go:332-340) that calls transport.Send; installing the MessageController as the node Transport places capture before the original send.

pending_store.meaning: Per-controller pending store keyed by message ID, holding stable cloned snapshots plus metadata; no scheduling policy is implemented.

entrypoint.meaning: Test-mode capture seam: every outbound protocol send arrives here (nodes use the controller as Config.Transport), is snapshotted, and is suppressed before the original send path.

message_capture.copy_strategy: Message.Clone() at capture time (Entry payloads deep-copied, message.go:38-46); ListPending returns value metadata in capture order, stable across calls.
message_capture.production_mode: Controller not installed: Node.emit delivers through the configured Transport unchanged and no capture occurs.
message_capture.test_mode: Active immediately after NewMessageController(Transport): Send captures message.Clone() with an incrementing CaptureSequence and returns nil, so the captured message does not continue into the wrapped transport (suppression).
notes: Capture happens in MessageController.Send before any call into the wrapped transport; the wrapped transport is never invoked for a captured message.
Pending IDs and CaptureSequence share one per-instance counter, so IDs are unique within the pending store (pending_store_instance scope).
Inject and ClearPending are serialized with a dedicated ops mutex; outbound Send/capture may proceed concurrently.

Target-node resolution for injection reuses the wrapped transport's registry (MemoryTransport nodes map) plus an optional explicit Register on the controller, so the thin external contract needs no extra registration API.

pending_store.meaning: Source of the injected snapshot; the selected message is consumed only after delivery succeeds, otherwise it stays pending.

entrypoint.meaning: Normal protocol input boundary (node.go:133-146) used by Inject delivery: validates message.To, re-clones, processes under the node mutex, and emits responses synchronously.

message_injection.copy_strategy: Injected message is the stored stable clone; Node.Step re-clones on entry (node.go:143), so sender, receiver, and content are never mutated.
message_injection.production_mode: No injection path in production; protocol messages enter nodes only through Step from the transport.
message_injection.test_mode: Inject(id) selects a pending message by ID, resolves the recorded target (message.To) via the controller registry or the wrapped transport's node registry, and delivers the stored stable snapshot through the target's Step.
notes: Injection resolves the recorded target through the controller's own registry first, then through the wrapped transport when it exposes nodes (*MemoryTransport registry or a nodeProvider interface); unknown targets yield ErrUnknownNode.
The pending message is deleted only after target.Step returns nil; on error (e.g., ErrPaused, ErrWrongTarget) it remains pending.
Delivery enters through Node.Step, the same boundary the original MemoryTransport.Send path uses (transport.go:44).
Inject and ClearPending are serialized (opsMu) with no IN_FLIGHT state; outbound capture may run concurrently.
